questions.question: Who was Alexander the Great's father?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that Alexander was the son of Philip II.
Incorrect. Darius III was the Persian king whom Alexander overthrew, not his father.
Incorrect. Aristotle was Alexander's tutor, not his father.
Incorrect. Porus was an Indian king defeated by Alexander, not his father.

questions.question: At what age did Alexander ascend to the throne?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says he ascended to the throne at the age of 20.
Incorrect. 16 is the age until which he was tutored by Aristotle, not the age he became king.
Incorrect. 30 is the age by which he had created one of the largest empires, not the age he ascended.
Incorrect. The article does not mention 25 as his age of accession.

questions.question: Where was Alexander the Great born?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that he was born in Pella, Macedon.
Incorrect. Babylon is where he later died, not where he was born.
Incorrect. Thebes is a city he destroyed, not his birthplace.
Incorrect. Alexandria is a city he founded, not his birthplace.

questions.question: Who tutored Alexander the Great until the age of 16?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Alexander was tutored by the philosopher Aristotle until age 16.
Incorrect. Philip II was his father, not his tutor.
Incorrect. Darius III was the Persian king he conquered, not his tutor.
Incorrect. Porus was an Indian king he fought, not his tutor.

questions.question: Which empire did Alexander invade in 334 BC?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states he launched a pan-Hellenic invasion of the Achaemenid Persian Empire in 334 BC.
Incorrect. The Roman Empire is not mentioned as a target of Alexander's invasion.
Incorrect. The Byzantine Empire existed much later and is not mentioned in this context.
Incorrect. The Macedonian Empire was his own, not the one he invaded.

questions.question: Who did Alexander overthrow after conquering the Achaemenid Empire?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states he overthrew Darius III and conquered the Achaemenid Empire.
Incorrect. Philip II was his father, not a Persian king.
Incorrect. Porus was an Indian king, not the Persian ruler.
Incorrect. Aristotle was his tutor, not a ruler he overthrew.

questions.question: In 326 BC, Alexander invaded India and achieved an important victory over which king?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states he achieved an important victory over Porus at the Battle of the Hydaspes.
Incorrect. Darius III was the Persian king, not an Indian king.
Incorrect. Philip II was his father, not an Indian king.
Incorrect. Aristotle was his tutor, not an Indian king.

questions.question: Where did Alexander the Great die in 323 BC?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states he died in Babylon, Mesopotamia.
Incorrect. Pella was his birthplace, not where he died.
Incorrect. Thebes was a city he destroyed, not his death place.
Incorrect. Alexandria is a city he founded, not his death place.

questions.question: Which city did Alexander plan to make the capital of his empire?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says Babylon was the city he had planned to make the capital of his empire.
Incorrect. Pella was his birthplace, not his planned capital.
Incorrect. Alexandria was a city he founded, but not the planned capital mentioned.
Incorrect. Thebes was destroyed, not planned as a capital.

questions.question: By what age had Alexander created one of the largest empires in history?
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that by the age of 30, he had created one of the largest empires in history.
Incorrect. 20 is the age he ascended to the throne, not when he created the empire.
Incorrect. 16 is the age until which he was tutored, not when he created the empire.
Incorrect. The article does not mention age 35 in this context.
